about: Measured seconds per test node id on GitHub-hosted runners (Tests runs 39846709837 attempt 1 and, for the former contract shard 5/6, 39790579549), for tests of 0.5 s or more. Read only by backend/tests/conftest.py to weight the DP_TEST_SHARD partition; a test missing here is spread by node-id hash. Never a selection: every collected test runs in exactly one shard.
